scope: HBase 2.6.6 unmodified checked-in cluster JUnit; offline source and archived-trace review only; no JVM, fault trial, or checklist edit

exact_target.healthy_path: An unexpired identifier must miss the first allKeys.get(keyId) at lines 134-138, then the watcher must not be aborted at line 139; only then can the selected check execute and avoid the expected InvalidToken at line 141.
exact_target.distinct_later_guard: The unconditional second masterKey-null check at line 159 is HBASE-34, not HBASE-33.

candidate_review.finding: MiniZK plus TokenServer setup waits for currentKey; generateToken signs with that key and the same manager immediately retrieves it. No source-backed first lookup miss is established.
Generates and selects the same current-key token, then checks TokenUtil.addTokenIfMissing; it does not supply a missing-key identifier to a server.
Key roll, deletion, and refresh are tested, but neither test invokes retrievePassword.

Secure LocalHBaseCluster tests obtain a freshly generated token and use it for authentication. Their source has no forced key-cache miss, and the prior MiniKdc setup failure does not establish a passing target path.
These tests obtain and inspect tokens keyed by cluster ID; they do not provide a missing-key token to a server.

call_search: Repository-wide rg of retrievePassword( in Java test files found only TestTokenAuthentication.java:424 as a direct test call. The production DIGEST authentication callback can call retrievePassword indirectly at DigestSaslServerAuthenticationProvider.java:76-77, but reviewed secure-cluster tests do not arrange the required cache miss.

archived_calibration.observed_trace: Two retrievePassword occurrences: @134 seq 41,88; @138 seq 42,89; HBASE-34 @159 seq 43,90. HBASE-33 @139 emitted zero events. The site catalog did bind exact @139 and @141 to target class SHA 29ff2466... and AppClassLoader; the missing event is not a target-ID mismatch.

fault_door_assessment: The configured RpcServer.call @447 service-call door cannot create the required first key-map miss for the direct same-manager test. ZooKeeper key refresh in retrievePassword occurs at line 153, after the selected @139 guard. A pretarget ZooKeeper fault during setup may disrupt key creation or abort the watcher, but no reviewed unmodified selector then passes an unexpired token whose key is absent from allKeys. No physical pretarget I/O fault door is admitted for this exact target under the current workload rule.

no_jvm_preflight.operations: Source git HEAD and SHA-256 checks; Python zipfile hashes of production/test class entries; Python tarfile/gzip inspection of archived site catalog and events; repository-wide rg of Java test retrievePassword calls; JSON syntax validation.
no_jvm_preflight.result: Source commit, files, compiled class entries, and archived target binding match the pinned identities; exact selected healthy check remains unobserved.

admission: Do not queue node1 HBASE-33 healthy bootstrap after HBASE-20. The next gate requires a source-backed existing passing test with an initial key-cache miss, or an explicit change to the unmodified-test workload rule. An expected InvalidToken from an unknown/expired token is not a new bug.
